summary: Unexpected midstream keepalive reset from internal LB closes SSE without terminal event, resumed session lacks final choice metadata
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports intermittent SSE sessions that abruptly close after an internal load-balancer keepalive reset. When clients reconnect and request resume, the stream continues but the final 'choice' object is missing terminal metadata (end_event flag and choice.finish_reason), resulting in partial outputs and downstream application hangs.

Impact: Two production endpoints used by BlueSignal Health (clinical note drafting) are intermittently losing final tokens or choice metadata for ~0.5-2% of long streaming responses (~1k-4k tokens). This causes the customer's UI to display an indefinite 'generating...' state and blocks automated downstream processing. Customer is on dedicated capacity and reports higher occurrence during traffic spikes and maintenance windows for their internal ALB.

Why this matters: Missing terminal metadata prevents canonicalization of the response and causes duplicate resume attempts. They have paused some workflows and are asking for an actionable workaround and root cause.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer opens SSE stream to /v1/streams with model redwood/gpt-large-v1 requesting streaming of a ~1500-3000 token generation and keepalive enabled (ping every 15s).
2) Traffic shaped with bursty requests to simulate spike; concurrently run an ALB keepalive reset test (close idle connections with FIN after 20s).
3) Observe SSE connection abruptly closes with no end_event and HTTP code 200 (client side sees connection close without terminal event).

4) Client reconnects with resume_token and receives sequence of choices but final choice lacks end_event flag and finish_reason key; last chunk contains truncated JSON fragment or is missing closing metadata.
logs: edge-proxy: 2026-03-10T14:12:03Z - conn id=1874 - nat keepalive reset from 10.8.7.12: FIN - downstream closed
serving-runtime: 2026-03-10T14:12:03Z - stream-session 0x9a3f - session closed without end_event, last-offset=48273
resume-handler: 2026-03-10T14:12:03Z - resume attempt accepted - returned_chunks=12 - terminal_meta_present=false
customer-client: websocket debug - reconnect payload includes resume_token=tok_abc123 - server returned chunk sequence 1..12 but no choice.finish_reason
investigation_notes: Initial triage (Support): replicated locally behind internal test ALB configured to aggressively close idle h2 connections; observed same behavior when ALB sent FIN during tail of stream.
Hypothesis 1: ALB FIN during HTTP/2 stream coalescing is causing TLS half-close path that the resume reassembly logic treats as a clean termination but drops trailing metadata frames.
Hypothesis 2: Keepalive/PROXY protocol interaction at edge-proxy may result in truncated last event if outgoing buffer is flushed mid-chunk (observed a 1-2 byte truncation in some traces).

Artifact: trace id=trace-311223-01 shows last packet ended mid-JSON delimiter ("\n\n") which our SSE parser expects to mark event boundary; parser considered stream ended and did not emit terminal event to the client session state machine.

Short-term workaround tested: extending ALB idle timeout to 90s eliminated reproductions in controlled tests. Client-side workaround of treating stream close as implicit end also viable but risky for other cases.
comments: Priya Patel (Support) 2026-03-10: Customer reported multiple occurrences during their morning traffic spike. They provided a pcap and server traces. Asked for priority escalation.

Marco Ruiz (SRE) 2026-03-10: Reproduced with internal ALB test harness; observed truncated final SSE event where trailing metadata ("finish_reason") was absent. Opening deeper investigation with runtime team.

Lina Gomez (Runtime Eng) 2026-03-11: Noted parser expects double-newline delimiter at chunk boundary. If connection closes while kernel-level flush splits delimiter, parser can mis-detect boundary. Proposing defensive parsing change to accept EOF as implicit event terminator when a partial delimiter has been seen.

Customer (BlueSignal Health - Eng) 2026-03-11: Thanks for quick triage. Extending ALB idle timeout to 90s reduced incidence in prod by observation window. Please advise permanent fix so we can revert config later.

Marco Ruiz (SRE) 2026-03-12: Filed internal runtime PR to make SSE parser tolerant of EOF-in-middle-of-delimiter and to emit terminal metadata when resume token indicates stream completion. Running integration tests against ALB failure scenarios.
resolution:
Workaround: Customer extended ALB idle timeout from 20s to 90s and workload errors dropped to ~0.05% during next 24h. We recommended a conservative client fallback: treat stream close with resume_token as terminal if no further chunks arrive within 3s.

Permanent fix in progress: runtime patch to make SSE parser treat EOF after partial delimiter as event boundary and to synthesize terminal choice metadata (finish_reason="abrupt_connection_close") when resume reconciliation confirms no outstanding tokens. PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4821 (in review). Scheduled rollout to canary Dedicated nodes 2026-03-15 and full rollout 2026-03-18 pending e2e verification.

Follow-ups: 1) Add unit/integration test simulating ALB FIN mid-delimiter. 2) Update runbook for Dedicated customers to include recommended ALB timeout settings. 3) Notify affected customers of fix and rollback guidance for ALB timeout changes.
